pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A classmate asks "Wie heißt du?" What is being asked? (1 mark)
   A. Your age
   B. Where you live
   C. How you feel
   D. Your name

2. Which word means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eltern
   B. die Kinder
   C. die Geschwister
   D. die Tanten

3. What does "die Küche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. kitchen
   C. radio
   D. garden

4. What does "das Wohnzimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. living room
   B. spoon
   C. cupboard or wardrobe
   D. lamp

5. What does "die Dusche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. shower
   B. cooker
   C. pot
   D. living room

6. Which day is between Montag and Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Samstag
   D. Donnerstag

7. What does "heute" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. today
   B. now
   C. always
   D. often

8. Which phrase is correct for "in the kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. in der Küche
   B. im Küche
   C. in die Küche
   D. in dem Küche

9. How is the letter K named in German? (1 mark)
   A. vay
   B. ess
   C. bay
   D. kah

10. What does "alt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. tall or big
   C. strong
   D. old

11. What does "die Tochter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. father
   B. brother
   C. daughter
   D. sister

12. In the guessing game, which sentence gives the answer "It is my father"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist meine Oma.
   B. Das ist mein Vater.
   C. Das ist meine Mutter.
   D. Das ist mein Bruder.

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. den
   D. der

14. Which day comes right before Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Montag
   C. Samstag
   D. Mittwoch

15. Which month comes right after "November"? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. Dezember
   C. Juni
   D. Juli

16. Which month comes right after "September"? (1 mark)
   A. Mai
   B. August
   C. Oktober
   D. Juni

17. Which food group does "das Wasser" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Obst
   D. das Fleisch

18. What does "das Mittagessen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. apple
   B. potato
   C. lunch
   D. milk

19. What does "der Fisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tea
   B. fish
   C. mango
   D. orange

20. What does "wolkig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. foggy
   C. wet
   D. cold

21. Which German word or phrase means "see you soon"? (1 mark)
   A. Danke
   B. Bis bald
   C. Ja
   D. Bitte

22. Which German word means "old"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. fleißig
   B. klein
   C. lustig
   D. alt

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

24. Which sentence is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Mein Vater sind groß.
   B. Mein Vater bist groß.
   C. Mein Vater ist groß.
   D. Mein Vater bin groß.

25. What is the plural of "der Stuhl"? (1 mark)
   A. die Stuhle
   B. die Stühle
   C. die Stuhls
   D. die Stuhler

26. Which little word goes with the noun "Zimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

27. Which German word or phrase means "cooker"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tisch
   B. der Herd
   C. die Küche
   D. die Dusche

28. Which German word or phrase means "Friday"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wochenende
   B. der Mittwoch
   C. der Freitag
   D. der Montag

29. Which day has a double t in the middle? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Samstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Montag

30. What does "April" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. November
   C. September
   D. July

31. Which German word or phrase means "balloon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Luftballon
   B. die Party
   C. das Lied
   D. das Geschenk

32. What is the plural of "die Kerze"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kerzer
   B. die Kerzes
   C. die Kerze
   D. die Kerzen

33. Which German word or phrase means "juice"? (1 mark)
   A. der Reis
   B. der Saft
   C. das Mittagessen
   D. der Kohl

34. Which meal word contains the special letter ü? (1 mark)
   A. Frühstück
   B. Abendessen
   C. Mittagessen
   D. Brot

35. Which German word or phrase means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kakao
   B. der Kohl
   C. das Fleisch
   D. die Orange

36. Which German word or phrase means "finger"? (1 mark)
   A. das Bein
   B. das Ohr
   C. der Kopf
   D. der Finger

37. Which German word or phrase means "back"? (1 mark)
   A. der Rücken
   B. das Knie
   C. das Auge
   D. der Bauch

38. Which German word or phrase means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. der Regen
   B. das Wetter
   C. der Wind
   D. der Nebel

39. What does "Gestern war es windig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday it was windy
   B. Today it is windy
   C. It is always windy
   D. Tomorrow it will be windy

40. Which German word or phrase means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. die Sonne
   B. der Nebel
   C. der Wind
   D. der Schnee

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them. (3 marks)

42. Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER. (2 marks)

43. Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow. (4 marks)

44. Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text. (2 marks)

45. Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop. (2 marks)

46. Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI. (4 marks)

47. Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home. (2 marks)

48. Write in German: "The sun is shining." (2 marks)

49. Write the German names of these months: July, August, September. (3 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate. (2 marks)

51. Write three German sentences describing a member of your family. (3 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese. (5 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain. (3 marks)

54. Write in German: "I have two ears." (2 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife. (4 marks)

56. Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12. (3 marks)

57. Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am". (3 marks)

58. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden. (2 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house. (2 marks)

60. You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist? (2 marks)

61. Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example. (2 marks)

62. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Your name
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?

2. A — die Eltern
   Eltern are the mother and father together.

3. B — kitchen
   die Küche means kitchen.

4. A — living room
   das Wohnzimmer means living room.

5. A — shower
   die Dusche means shower.

6. B — Dienstag
   The order is Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch.

7. A — today
   heute means today.

8. A — in der Küche
   Küche is a die word.

9. D — kah
   In German the letter K is called kah.

10. D — old
   alt means old.

11. C — daughter
   die Tochter means daughter.

12. B — Das ist mein Vater.
   Vater means father.

13. B — die
   It is die Wand, so the little word is die.

14. A — Donnerstag
   Before Freitag comes Donnerstag.

15. B — Dezember
   After November comes Dezember.

16. C — Oktober
   After September comes Oktober.

17. B — die Getränke
   das Wasser belongs to die Getränke.

18. C — lunch
   das Mittagessen means lunch.

19. B — fish
   der Fisch means fish.

20. A — cloudy
   wolkig means cloudy.

21. B — Bis bald
   see you soon in German is Bis bald.

22. D — alt
   old in German is alt.

23. C — die
   It is die Mutter, so the little word is die.

24. C — Mein Vater ist groß.
   Vater is he, so we use ist.

25. B — die Stühle
   The plural of der Stuhl is die Stühle.

26. D — das
   It is das Zimmer, so the little word is das.

27. B — der Herd
   cooker in German is der Herd.

28. C — der Freitag
   Friday in German is der Freitag.

29. C — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch is spelled with tt.

30. A — April
   April means April.

31. A — der Luftballon
   balloon in German is der Luftballon.

32. D — die Kerzen
   The plural of die Kerze is die Kerzen.

33. B — der Saft
   juice in German is der Saft.

34. A — Frühstück
   Frühstück (breakfast) has ü. Mittagessen and Abendessen have none.

35. C — das Fleisch
   meat in German is das Fleisch.

36. D — der Finger
   finger in German is der Finger.

37. A — der Rücken
   back in German is der Rücken.

38. A — der Regen
   rain in German is der Regen.

39. A — Yesterday it was windy
   gestern = yesterday and war = was.

40. A — die Sonne
   sun in German is die Sonne.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: kalt and Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Sonne scheint.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Juli, August, September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Opa, der Teller.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Knie, der Garten.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Bein, das Haus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).
